provenance.paper: Tulving, E. (1983). Elements of Episodic Memory; Nuxoll, A. M., & Laird, J. E. (2007). Extending cognitive architecture with episodic memory.
provenance.citation: Tulving, E. (1983). Oxford University Press (Ch. 7: encoding specificity and temporal organisation). Nuxoll, A. M., & Laird, J. E. (2007). Proceedings of AAAI 2007, 1560-1565 (cue-based retrieval of the best partially-matching episode).
provenance.locus: Tulving Ch. 7: episodic retrieval is organised by temporal context, not content alone; Nuxoll & Laird Section 3: activation-biased partial matching of cue against stored episodes.
provenance.notes: Two kitchen episodes share equal content overlap with the cue (Jaccard 0.5 each); temporal proximity (breakfast at t=9 vs dinner at t=2, cue at t=10) breaks the tie exactly as Tulving's temporal organisation predicts: score(breakfast) = 0.5 + 1/2 = 1.0 > score(dinner) = 0.5 + 1/9 ≈ 0.6111.

input.intent: recall the most relevant kitchen episode

expected.notes: Equal Jaccard (1/2 each); the temporal kernel 1/(1+|Δt|) decides: 0.5 vs 0.1111.
